q1_issues.issue: "The PacifiCats" is a capitalized proper name (a named vessel class) but is silently converted into the common kind `pacificat` with no `(Name ...)` atom at all, against the rule that every proper noun — vessels included — carries exactly one Name fact.

"Robert Allan Limited of Australia" is an entity-attached genitive, yet it is rendered as the positional claim `(LocatedIn robert_allan_limited australia)` instead of the ordinary genitive `Possession`, asserting a position the text never states — while the sister phrase "Philip Hercus from Vancouver" is correctly kept as the surface `From`.

q2_gaps: plural proper name denoting a named class/series ("the PacifiCats") — the instruction set has no rule for a pluralized proper noun that is simultaneously a name and the kind its members belong to

entity-attached "of" naming an organization's country or affiliation ("Robert Allan Limited of Australia") — the of-phrase rules cover possessive, partitive, measure and about-phrases, but not an origin/affiliation designator
notes: Splitting the coordinated by-phrase into two design events follows the default distributive coordination rule, and `design` taking `Patient` (a creation verb) is right.
